name: kilo-mms
description: Staged delivery loop for Kilo: clarify, chart, build, prove, converge, land-learn, routed by deliver, with planner/researcher/implementor/reviewer/approver/advisor subagents.

notes.excluded: .kilo/workshop, .kilo/plans and .kilo/run are development-only or runtime state and are never installed.
notes.config: .kilo/kilo.json defaults all roles to kilo/ollama-cloud/glm-5.3-flash and pins planner/advisor escalation to kilo/openai/gpt-6.1-sol (Kilo Gateway OpenAI BYOK — credits/key required for planner/advisor calls). Remove the agent model keys to inherit the default model instead.
